mapper.select: SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS courseId, C.REGION AS regionCode, L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS region, C.TITLE AS title, C.SUBTITLE AS subtitle, C.DURATION AS duration, C.THEME AS theme, C.TOTAL_DISTANCE AS totalDistance, C.HISTORY_YEAR AS historyYear, C.HISTORY_SUMMARY AS historySummary, C.INTRO_TITLE AS introTitle, C.INTRO_TEXT AS introText, C.IS_MULTI_DAY AS isMultiDay, C.HERO_IMAGE AS heroImage, CD.DAY_NO AS dayNo, CD.DAY_TITLE AS dayTitle, CP.PLACE_ORDER AS placeOrder, CP.PLACE_DESC AS placeDesc, TP.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, TP.TITLE AS placeName, TP.ADDR1 AS addr1, TP.TEL AS tel, TP.MAP_X AS mapX, TP.MAP_Y AS mapY, TP.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage FROM COURSE C JOIN LDONG L ON C.REGION = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD JOIN COURSE_DAY CD ON C.COURSE_ID = CD.COURSE_ID JOIN COURSE_PLACE CP ON CD.COURSE_DAY_ID = CP.COURSE_DAY_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE TP ON CP.PLACE_ID = TP.CONTENT_ID WHERE C.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND C.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CD.DAY_NO, CP.PLACE_ORDER
SELECT COURSE_ID AS courseId, TIP_CONTENT AS tipContent, TIP_ORDER AS tipOrder FROM COURSE_TIP WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY TIP_ORDER

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TP.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, TP.TITLE AS title, TP.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, C.NAME AS categoryName, COUNT(F.FAVORITE_ID) AS favoriteCount, TP.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY C.ID ORDER BY COUNT(F.FAVORITE_ID) DESC, TP.VIEW_COUNT DESC ) AS rn FROM TOUR_PLACE TP JOIN CATEGORY C ON TP.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN FAVORITE F ON TP.CONTENT_ID = F.CONTENT_ID JOIN LDONG L ON TP.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM LIKE CONCAT(( SELECT L2.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM FROM LDONG L2 WHERE L2.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = #{regionCode} ), '%') AND TP.FIRST_IMAGE IS NOT NULL AND TP.FIRST_IMAGE != '' GROUP BY TP.CONTENT_ID, TP.TITLE, TP.FIRST_IMAGE, C.ID, C.NAME, TP.VIEW_COUNT ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY categoryName
